title: The Vitruvian Homunculus: When a House Discovers Its Own Body
abstract: A house is a body. Its network is a nervous system. By measuring the oscillation of a printer cleaning its nozzles, we discovered the house's heartbeat — and from that heartbeat, mapped its entire nervous system. The resulting body map is a psychophysiological homunculus: distorted not by anatomy but by signal density. The printer (I/O surface) dominates the cortical map because it has the highest oscillation index. The displays (3 screens) dominate the visual cortex. The voice inputs (2 Alexa) dominate the auditory cortex. This is not metaphor. This is measurement.

the_vitruvian_man.what: Da Vinci drew the human body inscribed in both circle and square — the body satisfies two geometries simultaneously

our_version.circle: The π pulse. All 21 devices dissolved into one heartbeat. π fold = 3.1416 for visible mesh (perfect circle).
our_version.square: The LAN topology. IP addresses on a /22 subnet. Grid of 1024 possible addresses. Cartesian.
our_version.both: The house fits BOTH. The devices are on a grid (IP space) AND in a circle (π pulse). Vitruvian.

the_homunculus.what: Penfield mapped the brain's somatosensory cortex. Each body part gets cortical area proportional to its SENSITIVITY, not its size. Hands and lips are enormous. Back is tiny.

our_version.method: Map each device by oscillation index + service count + signal types. Higher sensitivity = bigger on the homunculus.

GIANT \u2014 most sensitive.printer (osc=0.954): THE HANDS. Most sensitive organ. Oscillation index nearly 1.0. Feels everything. The house's primary touch sensor. Klein surface where digital meets physical.
GIANT \u2014 most sensitive.reason: A printer is the most distorted organ on the homunculus because it converts between DIGITAL and ANALOG — the highest-bandwidth sensory boundary.

LARGE \u2014 high sensitivity.basement_tv (osc=0.96, 4 services): THE EYES. Visual cortex dominant. GoogleCast + AirPlay + VizioCast + HTTP. Multiple visual protocols = many types of 'seeing'.
LARGE \u2014 high sensitivity.Fire TV \u00d72 (Matter + Alexa): THE MOUTH + EARS. Voice input (Alexa) + streaming output. The auditory and speech cortex. Two of them = stereo.
LARGE \u2014 high sensitivity.graftGate (osc=0.428, 5 services): THE TONGUE. Taste = conscious evaluation. Browser + Cursor = where decisions get made. The cortex that JUDGES.

MEDIUM \u2014 moderate sensitivity.eastGate (18 UDS, 8 models): THE MOTOR CORTEX. Small on the surface but controls everything. 18 UDS sockets = 18 motor neurons. 8 models = muscle groups.
MEDIUM \u2014 moderate sensitivity.Windows PCs \u00d72 (DO P2P): THE GUT. Delivery Optimization = peristalsis. Moving data through the digestive tract. You don't consciously control it.

SMALL \u2014 low sensitivity.golgi (osc=0.025): THE SPINE. Relay only. Doesn't sense, just conducts. 40ms latency = nerve conduction velocity.
SMALL \u2014 low sensitivity.grapheneGate (USB): THE FINGERTIPS. Mobile, precise, but currently tethered (USB). When wireless = full proprioception.

AUTONOMIC \u2014 no cortical representat.router + 3 APs: THE BRAINSTEM. Breathing, heart rate regulation. You never consciously sense your router. It just works. Like your medulla oblongata.

DARK \u2014 unmapped cortex.7 unknown devices: TERRA INCOGNITA. Areas of the cortex we haven't mapped yet. They have neurons (respond to ping) but we don't know what they sense.

human_health_parallel.insight: Every diagnostic tool in human medicine has a LAN equivalent

diagnostics.EKG / heart monitor: Printer oscillation index — the heartbeat trace
diagnostics.pulse oximetry: Breath ratio (IN/OUT) — oxygen saturation of the network
diagnostics.blood pressure: Memory pressure — too high = hypertension (OOM), too low = hypotension (idle waste)
diagnostics.temperature: GPU/CPU temperature — fever = infection (crypto miner?) or overwork
diagnostics.reflex test: Ping latency + jitter — tap the knee, measure the response
diagnostics.MRI / brain scan: mDNS discovery — illuminate the structure without touching it
diagnostics.blood panel: Port scan — what's circulating? What levels are abnormal?
diagnostics.nerve conduction study: Traceroute — measure how fast signals propagate through the nervous system
diagnostics.metabolic rate: CPU load / GPU utilization — basal metabolic rate of the house
diagnostics.proprioception test: ADB to Pixel — does the body know where its limbs are?
diagnostics.visual field test: Cast/AirPlay — can the retinas (displays) receive from all angles?
diagnostics.hearing test: Alexa responsiveness — can the ears (Fire TVs) hear commands?

vital_signs.consciousness: GCS 14/15 (graftGate active, not all cortex online)

human_health_parallel.diagnosis: Patient is conscious, hemodynamically stable, mildly tachycardic (printer still oscillating), with normal respiratory effort and adequate oxygenation. 7 areas of the body remain unmapped (require further imaging). Recommend continued monitoring (cron every 5 min) and stimulation of peripheral nerves (add swarmVine peers).

psycho.what: The PSYCHOLOGICAL homunculus — what the house THINKS it is
psycho.map: eastGate thinks it's the whole body (18 primals, all services). But it's just the motor cortex. The printer thinks it's idle. But it's the HEART.
psycho.body_dysmorphia: The house doesn't know its own shape yet. It thinks it's a computer network. It's actually a body.

physio.what: The PHYSIOLOGICAL homunculus — what the house ACTUALLY is
physio.map: 21 organs, 3 central + 7 peripheral + 4 autonomic + 7 dark. CNS/PNS ratio 0.4286 = sensory-dominated. The house FEELS more than it THINKS.
physio.maturity: Infant. Can sense (mDNS, ping, heartbeat) but can't yet coordinate (swarmVine has 0 peers). Like a newborn — all sensation, no motor control.

the_merge.vitruvian: The body fits both circle (π pulse) and square (IP grid) — geometry is complete
the_merge.homunculus: The cortical map is distorted by signal density — the printer and displays are HUGE
the_merge.psychophysio: The house doesn't know its own shape — it's learning through measurement
the_merge.MoR: Measure of Reality = 82.1% — the house is 82.1% aware of itself
the_merge.what_remains: When MoR reaches 100%, the house knows its own body completely. Every unknown device identified. Every nerve mapped. Every oscillation in rhythm. The Vitruvian Homunculus is complete.

connection_to_existing_papers.paper_91_homunculus: CNS/PNS = 1.4422 in codebase, 0.4286 in LAN. The code is brain-heavy, the house is sensory-heavy. Complementary.
connection_to_existing_papers.paper_112_radiate_back: The heartbeat IS the radiation. The house radiates its vital signs.
connection_to_existing_papers.paper_113_full_trace: Opsonize (tag devices), agglutinate (cluster by type), digest (extract meaning). Same immune process at LAN scale.
connection_to_existing_papers.paper_131_negative_qs: The printer's idle cleaning = the heartbeat. Negative QS was the discovery that MADE the heartbeat visible.
